xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3308: The file-size guard hands agents a paste-ready ratchet-up line — 2 of 3 agents raised the ceiling instead of shrinking the file

plan.title: The file-size guard hands agents a paste-ready ratchet-up line — 2 of 3 agents raised the ceiling instead of shrinking the file
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: scripts/lint-file-size.sh:171-176 offers raising the allowlist ceiling as an equal remedy and prints the paste-ready row with the new, larger count. Two of three agents that hit the guard on launcher-generator.ts raised the cap instead of shrinking the file. The planner prompt (src/lib/cloister/prompts/planning.md:168) also tells planners to prescribe allowlist rows. Nothing distinguishes an agent's raise from the operator's, and the Flywheel (conv-flywheel) is exempt from the main-push guard because it is a conversation.
narratives.Proposal: Rewrite the guard's failure text to name only the shrink path and state that the allowlist number must not increase. Extract a shared pusher-identity helper (scripts/lib/pusher-identity.sh) that keeps the conv-* exemption but always classifies the Flywheel as an agent, and use it in guard-agent-main-push.sh. Add scripts/guard-allowlist-raise.sh, run from .husky/pre-push, which refuses an agent push whose range raises any path's effective allowlist cap above max(allowance at base, allowance at the remote tip), with OVERDECK_OPERATOR_PUSH=1 as the operator escape. Rewrite the planner prompt sentence and document the operator-only raise in the A3 doc. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-3308.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Closing the `git push --no-verify` bypass of pre-push guards
- Running the raise guard in CI `npm run lint` (CI has no pusher identity)
- Building #4344 (main-push guard for registered projects), #4345 (gate-integrity bundled rule) or #4346 (context-budget ratchet)
- Changing how lint-file-size.sh computes allowed counts, or an absolute ban on raises that would also block the operator
- Any new exemption: OVERDECK_CONVERSATION=conv-* without a conv-* OVERDECK_AGENT_ID must not become an operator conversation
- Editing existing rows in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt
- Any change to src/**/*.ts production code

autoDecisions.summary: Raises are operator-only (refused for agent pushers at pre-push), not banned outright as the issue body's request #2 asked.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator-approved design posted on the issue (2026-09-29, from .pan/drafts/deft-adoption.md Issue 1) supersedes the older issue body and explicitly keeps an operator raise path; an absolute ban would block the operator too. Issue AC2 is satisfied for every agent pusher by the raise-guard item's tests.

autoDecisions.summary: A raise is measured against max(allowance at base, allowance at the remote tip), with the remote tip passed as --prior by the pre-push hook.
autoDecisions.rationale: Feature-branch base is merge-base(origin/main, tip), so an operator raise pushed with OVERDECK_OPERATOR_PUSH=1 would stay in range forever and block every later agent or server-side push of that branch. Grandfathering what is already on the remote branch keeps the gate about what this push introduces.

autoDecisions.summary: Flywheel detection uses OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=conv-flywheel, OVERDECK_CONVERSATION=conv-flywheel, or OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY=flywheel:*.
autoDecisions.rationale: OVERDECK_AGENT_ID is exported for conversations only under Herdr/supervisor/pi/codex/acp (conversation-runtime.ts:799) while OVERDECK_CONVERSATION is exported for every conversation (:804); OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY is exported into spawned agents (spawn.ts:447,866). The design asked to exclude conv-flywheel and any flywheel:-started context.

autoDecisions.summary: Tighten the main-push guard for conv-flywheel in the same change via the shared helper.
autoDecisions.rationale: The design says to tighten the exemption in the same change and #4344/#4346 reuse the tightened identity test. The Flywheel's only main pushes are .pan/flywheel/*.md (pan-flywheel SKILL.md:197-232), which are not code paths, so it keeps working.

autoDecisions.summary: Rewrite the planner prompt sentence at src/lib/cloister/prompts/planning.md:168 as part of this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: It instructs planners to prescribe an allowlist row whenever an item grows a god file, which is the same teaching surface the issue removes from the guard message.

autoDecisions.summary: verify_commands use targeted vitest files plus npm run lint/typecheck instead of the issue's `npm test`.
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo rule forbids running the full npm test on the host; CI runs it against the PR head.

metadata.sizeJustification: One coherent gate change in shell scripts and their tests: 13 files, mostly scripts/ plus one test per script. The subsystem count comes from path roots (scripts, scripts/lib, tests, .husky, sync-sources, src prompt text, docs), not independent features. The pieces are not independently shippable as sibling issues: the raise guard is inert until wired into the hook, the message change without the guard leaves the raise unguarded, and the helper exists only for the two guards. Items are already split small with a 3-edge DAG.

New scripts/guard-allowlist-raise.sh refuses agent pushes that raise a file-size ceiling

expected_outputs: tests/unit/scripts/guard-allowlist-raise.test.ts passes all twelve PRD WI-4 cases

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4 steps 1-12. Interface: `bash scripts/guard-allowlist-raise.sh --range <base>..<head> [--prior <sha>]`. Order: OVERDECK_OPERATOR_PUSH=1 → exit 0; malformed/missing range → fail closed exit 1 with 'trust gate'; non-agent pusher (overdeck_pusher_is_agent) → exit 0; unresolvable base/head → fail closed; allowlist untouched in range → exit 0. Effective cap per path = LAST row. Allowance at rev = effective cap if present, else max(line count at rev, CEILING=1000) if the file exists, else 1000. Priors = base plus --prior when non-empty, not all zeros, and resolvable. Refuse (exit 1, stderr listing '<path> <prior> → <head_cap>' and naming OVERDECK_OPERATOR_PUSH=1 and the A3 doc) when any head effective cap exceeds the max prior allowance. Print no line in allowlist-row format. Tests template on guard-agent-main-push.test.ts; installScript copies both the guard and scripts/lib/pusher-identity.sh; strip OVERDECK_CONVERSATION, OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY, OVERDECK_OPERATOR_PUSH unless a case sets them.

items.title: Given a range raising src/x.ts from 1012 to 1018 with OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=agent-pan-1 or conv-flywheel, the guard exits non-zero and its output contains 'src/x.ts 1012 → 1018'
Given the same raise with OVERDECK_AGENT_ID=conv-123, or with OVERDECK_OPERATOR_PUSH=1, or with a human git identity and no agent env, the guard exits 0
Given an agent range that only lowers a row, or does not touch the allowlist, the guard exits 0; an appended later row for the same path with a higher value is refused (last row wins)
Given a new row above the base allowance (1100 for an absent file, 1250 for a 1200-line file with no base row) the guard exits non-zero, and rows at the allowance (1000, 1200) exit 0
Given a raise already present at the --prior sha, an agent range base..B exits 0; the same range without --prior exits non-zero; --range '' exits non-zero with 'trust gate'
